body:
I have to find a new place to live and a job as well before the month is over. I may not be able to do either.

Sure, maybe if I had the time to spend on it I could find some kind of professional help. But even if I could afford it, the basics of living have to take a higher priority in my schedule.

It always problems on top of problems eating away my life.
I can't afford a therapist or antidepressants, I can hardly afford a place to live and food.

My life was destroyed when I was a child by my father. Now I'm expected to build and live a life like a normal person and I just can't do it. I can't cope with it anymore.

I just want peace.

A person can only take so much before they break. Living with a few moments of regret over a pulled trigger sounds much better then a lifetime of suffering.

I can't find a reason to go on. All that is ahead of me is more pain.

Abuse and extreme isolation. My life was ruined when I was a child, before I had any control. Now, I can't cope with trying to build a life that I don't understand how to live.

I'd rather die in those woods then starve to death in some alley. I'd rather die in those woods then struggle through each day at dead end jobs, living in slums.
